meta.title: Validation Gates — machine-readable
meta.note: Gates must be registered before a scored window opens. Changing a gate after results exist is a gate violation and is recorded as such.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: hold the threshold against n_eff, not raw n

gates.name: Robustness
criteria: edge sign stable across window halves
edge survives a second independent window
placebo shuffles do not reproduce edge

gates.name: Risk of ruin
gates.auto_fail: unbounded downside with no stated cap

gates.name: Economic reality
criteria: edge survives using only release-time best quote
no implausible stake to produce claimed ROI

gates.name: Demotion gate (live -> paper)
gates.scope: any strategy whose status is live (funded or paper-promoted)

triggers.rule: two consecutive registered windows with negative flat-stake (signal-basis) ROI
triggers.note: operational form of the scoring rule 'two failed windows demote'

triggers.rule: rolling 300 settled bets: hit rate below break-even with z <= -1.96
max drawdown > 25% of bankroll under the registered staking rule
mean CLV negative over the last 100 settled bets
triggers.note: INACTIVE until a price feed exists (Q-02); recorded here so it cannot be forgotten

triggers.rule: Brier skill score vs market-implied negative in two consecutive windows
triggers.note: requires price feed for market-implied benchmark (Q-02)

triggers.rule: any G0 provenance violation (lookahead, unlicensed input, unlogged settlement rule)

action.status_change: live -> paper, effective at the next settlement batch (immediately for D6)
action.positions: open live positions settle normally; new positions at paper stakes only
action.bankroll: frozen: no additions or removals while demoted
action.leaderboard: status shows 'demoted' with the trigger id; the strategy cannot rank in live leaderboards
action.log: every demotion appended to data/demotion_log.jsonl (strategy, trigger, evidence, window, timestamp)

reentry: one full shadow window at paper stakes
pass gates G0-G7 again on the shadow window
one clean live-probation window before restored standing
never automatic; re-entry is recorded in the demotion log
gates.authority: mechanical: triggers fire without discretion. Manual override requires an owner note in COORDINATION.md with reasons.

scoring_rules: score only inside the registered window
passes are logged (a strategy with no denominator is invalid)
report raw and top-5%-trimmed ROI together
champion requires two consecutive qualifying windows
two failed windows demote; no sitting on old results
challenger runs a full shadow window before displacing a champion
all entrants evaluated on identical frozen inputs
G8 demotion is mechanical: any trigger demotes live -> paper; re-entry only via shadow window + full gate pass (see docs/methodology/demotion-gate.md)

rewards.season_0: paper league - titles and badges only, no funded pool
rewards.season_1_plus: requires funded pool, eligibility rules and jurisdiction review (Q-07)
design_rules: no reward for a single hot window
vacate and log titles later shown invalid
